timing: sum of synchronized Engine.generate wall times, includes prefill and detokenization; excludes loading and disjoint training warmup

dataset.name: GSM8K
dataset.template: raw completion, training examples 0..4 with arithmetic annotations removed
dataset.warning: performance subset, not full GSM8K or official Qwen/DeepSeek accuracy evaluation

protocol.warmup: 4 disjoint training questions 512..515, 128 generated tokens each
protocol.cold: unseen shuffled test questions after disjoint train warmup
protocol.reused: same test questions in same order after cold phase; online trie retains previous outputs
protocol.native: ASCEND_USE_FIA=false, full decode graph and overlap enabled
protocol.fia: ASCEND_USE_FIA=true, full decode graph and overlap enabled
protocol.ngram: ASCEND_USE_FIA=true, NGRAM, eager/synchronous, D=12, capacity=10M, no external corpus
protocol.external4: NGRAM plus first 256 training documents, external SAM budget=4
protocol.external11: NGRAM plus same training documents, external SAM budget=11
protocol.qwen_4b_repeats: 2 fresh-engine runs on physical devices 0/2 with reversed case order

interpretation.negative_scope: unseen first pass on all tested models; Qwen3-0.6B expanded subset and MLA pilot even on replay
interpretation.accuracy_caveat: Qwen3-4B replay: NGRAM 53/64 versus native/FIA 54/64 in both runs. 2/64 output sequences differ from FIA; one baseline-correct answer reaches the output cap without a strict final answer. This does not establish accuracy-preserving acceleration.
